features.name: Independence Visitor Center
features.description: The Independence Visitor Center is the practical first stop for current NPS schedules, maps, films, city guidance, accessible restrooms, loaner wheelchairs, a cafe and free Wi-Fi.

details.imageAlt: Independence Visitor Center at Independence National Historical Park

features.name: Liberty Bell Center
features.description: The Liberty Bell Center is a free, unticketed, self-guided exhibit at 526 Market Street, with the Bell at the south end and a separate security line at the north entrance.
features.source_label: NPS Liberty Bell Center visitor guide

details.informationSourceLabel: NPS Liberty Bell Center visitor guide
details.imageAlt: Liberty Bell Center at Independence National Historical Park

features.name: Independence Hall and Independence Square
features.description: Independence Hall is the signed-document landmark inside the secured Independence Square block, with a free morning open house and timed daytime tours that use separate ticket and accessibility rules.

details.imageAlt: Independence Hall and Independence Square at Independence National Historical Park

features.name: Franklin Court and Benjamin Franklin Museum
features.description: Franklin Court combines a free accessible courtyard and ghost-house frames with the ticketed underground Benjamin Franklin Museum, Printing Office and B. Free Franklin Post Office on different schedules.
features.source_label: NPS Benjamin Franklin Museum visitor guide

details.informationSourceLabel: NPS Benjamin Franklin Museum visitor guide
details.imageAlt: Franklin Court and Benjamin Franklin Museum at Independence National Historical Park

features.name: President's House Site
features.description: The President's House Site is a free outdoor exhibit at 6th and Market that uses preserved foundations, open-captioned media and first-person stories to examine the presidency, freedom and enslavement.
features.source_label: NPS President's House Site visitor guide

details.informationSourceLabel: NPS President's House Site visitor guide
details.imageAlt: President's House Site at Independence National Historical Park

features.name: Congress Hall
features.description: Congress Hall is the free former U.S. Capitol beside Independence Hall, reached through Independence Square security and visited through a morning open house or scheduled ranger tours.

details.imageAuthor: tim eschaton from Los Angeles, USA
details.imageAlt: Congress Hall at Independence National Historical Park

features.name: Old City Hall
features.description: Old City Hall contains the restored 1790s U.S. Supreme Court chamber at 5th and Chestnut, offering a free first-come visit outside the Independence Square security checkpoint.
features.source_label: NPS Old City Hall visitor guide

details.informationSourceLabel: NPS Old City Hall visitor guide
details.imageAlt: Old City Hall at Independence National Historical Park

features.name: Washington Square and Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
features.description: Washington Square is a free 24-hour landscaped public park and Level One arboretum centered on the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier of the American Revolution, southeast of Independence Hall.

details.imageAlt: Washington Square and Tomb of the Unknown Soldier at Independence National Historical Park
